source_review.notes: Checked the active FAA AC 25.1309-1B record and PDF; four NASA records on redundancy, CCF modes, diversity, and life-support architecture; NRC NUREG-2225, CCF database guidance, and digital I&C fault-injection research; and IAEA SSG-39. All ten final URLs returned HTTP 200. Regulatory guidance, empirical classifications, model abstractions, and chapter synthesis are distinguished.

evidence: Reviewed binomial k-out-of-n success notation and its identical independent channel assumptions.
Reviewed ideal one-out-of-n failure q^n and the declared shared-event mixture q_c+(1-q_c)q_i^n.
Reviewed coverage/switching conditional semantics and indexed CCF component-group notation.
Reviewed readiness chain separating function, architecture, fault model, independence, coverage, quantification, verification, and lifecycle validity.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Probabilities, rates, conditional probabilities, and categorical event classifications are not mixed; assumptions are stated at each use.

evidence: Executed redundancy-common-cause-floor-fixture under python3 with exact output recorded in artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-068/report.json.
Recomputed ideal one-, two-, and three-channel failures as 0.02, 0.0004, and 0.000008.
Recomputed mixture failures as 0.02098, 0.0013996, and 0.001007992 for q_c=0.001 and q_i=0.02.
Recomputed the two-to-three-channel improvement factor as 1.388503 after six-decimal rounding.
Verified the common-cause lower bound for n=1 through 19.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The inputs are synthetic dimensionless probabilities; no operational parameter estimate or rate conversion is claimed.

evidence: Confirmed the k-out-of-n expression is the upper binomial tail under identical independent Bernoulli channels.
Confirmed ideal one-out-of-n failure is q^n only under independence.
Confirmed q_c+(1-q_c)q_i^n is at least q_c for every positive integer n.
Confirmed the mixture approaches q_c as n grows when 0<=q_i<1.
Confirmed the one-channel mixture differs from the ideal reference because it includes a shared branch.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The mixture is explicitly one model, not a universal beta-factor convention or causal proof.

evidence: Challenged active, standby, load-sharing, voting, switching, split-brain, dormant, spurious, Byzantine, and cascading behavior.
Reviewed shared requirements, sensing, data, tools, suppliers, power, clocks, networks, environment, location, maintenance, credentials, people, and governance.
Reviewed superficial diversity, disagreement/arbitration, common specification/oracle, and supplier/sub-tier coupling.
Reviewed definite/potential/independent event classification, exposure denominators, censoring, model transfer, parameter uncertainty, and sensitivity.
Reviewed hidden synchrony, post-event recovery, simultaneous adverse challenges, updates, and analysis stopping criteria.
Reviewed all ten worked examples and five complete answers for assumptions, reasoning, evidence limits, and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Production claims require domain regulator/certification, safety, reliability/PRA/statistical, architecture, hardware, software/data/cybersecurity, operator/maintainer, human-factors, supplier, configuration, test, technical-authority, and risk-acceptance review.

evidence: Confirmed protected function, mission, success logic, modes, boundary, and fault set precede channel counting.
Confirmed independence is mechanism-specific and never inferred from separate labels or boxes.
Confirmed redundancy-management and support elements remain within the reliability boundary.
Confirmed coverage stages and standby/load-sharing conditions remain separately evidence-bearing.
Confirmed CCF parameters retain group, failure mode, population, environment, basis, period, model, and uncertainty.
Confirmed additional redundancy is traded against new serial elements, complexity, false action, maintenance, resources, and safety.
invariant_checking.notes: No ideal low probability, redundancy count, diversity label, or one-at-a-time test is presented as proof of independence or safety.

proof_review.notes: The chapter derives elementary reliability identities and bounds but presents no theorem proof.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: The executable result is labeled synthetic_parameters_only.
The fixture disclaims real rates, populations, uncertainty estimates, and independence claims.
FAA, NASA, NRC, and IAEA material is attributed without claiming product compliance or approval.

empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Synthetic arithmetic, historical/agency evidence, internal review, and real-system assurance remain explicitly separated.
